title: Swinging load transit and dock
summary: A carrier rests on two small ledges between the gripper's open fingers. It is a short bar with a pendulum (a rod ending in a ball) hanging from a hinge under it, and the pendulum is already swinging. Grip the bar with both fingers and damp the swing. Carry the carrier, still gripped, through two waypoints without letting the carrier or its pendulum touch a block obstacle, and damp the residual swing again. Finally lower it until the pendulum's ball rests centred in a dock, with the swing settled and the bar still gripped.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0) facing +x (yaw 0). No tool: the stock Panda hand with its two fingers. The tool frame (the reported tool pose) is the hand's TCP, the point between the fingertips, with its z axis pointing out of the hand along the fingers. At the start the TCP is at (-0.03, -0.14, 0.36), exactly at the carrier bar's centre, with the gripper pointing straight down (orientation wxyz (0, 1, 0, 0)). The fingers close along world y and start partly open, at 0.016 m each (aperture 0.032 m), straddling the 30 mm wide bar. The action's last component is the total aperture, 0 to 0.08 m. In this task the finger servo is stiffer (kp 800, kd 8), and finger motion is not time-synchronised with the arm joints.
scene: The carrier is a free rigid assembly, not attached to the robot or the scene. Its bar is blue-grey, 0.12 m long (along world x at the start), 0.03 m wide and 18 mm thick. A pendulum hangs from a hinge just under the bar's middle: a grey 12 mm square rod, 0.15 m long (`length`), ending in an orange ball (the bob) of radius 22 mm. The hinge lets the pendulum swing only in the vertical plane along the bar's length, with almost no friction. At t = 0 the bar rests on two thin static ledges (on posts), and the pendulum is let go from an angle, so it is already swinging. A static orange block obstacle (0.08 m x 0.12 m x 0.11 m tall) stands on the table. A static blue open box (the dock: 0.104 m x 0.10 m inside, walls 55 mm high) is placed low over the table. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Carrier: free articulation whose root link `carrier` (the bar, box 0.12 x 0.03 x 0.018 m, mass 0.055 kg) starts with its centre at (-0.03, -0.14, 0.36), level, resting on the two ledges. The ledges `reset_handle_stand_-1/1` are static plates 0.008 x 0.09 x 0.006 m centred at (-0.083, -0.177, 0.348) and (0.023, -0.177, 0.348), with posts to the table. The pendulum link `load` (mass 0.06 kg) hangs from a revolute hinge 0.012 m below the bar's centre (z = 0.348 at the start). The hinge axis is the bar's y axis (world y at the start), limits +-1.3 rad, joint friction 0.00001, damping 0.00003. The rod is 0.012 x 0.012 x `length` (0.15 m); the bob (radius 0.022, friction 0.4) is centred `length` below the hinge. q is the hinge angle relative to the bar; q > 0 displaces the bob towards -x by `length` sin q. At reset q = `initial_angle` + e, with e ~ U(-0.02, 0.02) the only seeded draw (nominal 0.25 rad, i.e. the bob about 3.7 cm towards -x). The pendulum is released at rest. Idle, it keeps swinging at about +-0.25 rad with a period of about 1 s and practically no decay. Obstacle: static box 0.08 x 0.12 x 0.11 m centred at (0.08, 0, 0.055). Dock: static open box (inner half 0.052 x 0.05, walls 0.055 m, 5 mm floor) whose floor top is at (0.07, 0.19, 0.015). The load_dock predicate tests the bob centre against the world point (0.07, 0.19) and the height z = 0.037. `goal` = (0.07, 0.19, `length` + 0.049) = (0.07, 0.19, 0.199), the bar-centre position when the bob rests in the dock. Waypoints are fixed (see world_goals_fixed).

phases.name: grasp_settle_and_damp
phases.text: Both fingers grip the bar (bilateral grip: the left finger or its pad and the right finger or its pad both in contact with the bar at that step), and the swing is settled: the pendulum's hinge angle relative to the bar is less than 0.07 rad in magnitude and its hinge rate is below 0.18 rad/s. This must hold for 0.35 s without interruption.

phases.name: obstacle_transit
phases.text: With the bar gripped by both fingers, the bar's centre (the carrier's root origin) comes within 3.5 cm of waypoint A = (-0.05, 0.04, 0.38).

phases.name: turn_and_brake
phases.text: With the bar gripped by both fingers, the bar's centre comes within 3.5 cm of waypoint B = (0.0, 0.15, 0.37).

phases.name: residual_swing_cancel
phases.text: Bar gripped by both fingers and swing settled (|hinge angle| < 0.07 rad, |hinge rate| < 0.18 rad/s), for 0.5 s without interruption.

phases.name: load_dock
phases.text: Bar gripped by both fingers and swing settled (as above). The pendulum (rod or bob) has touched the dock within the last 10 ms. The bob's centre is within 3.5 cm horizontally of the dock's centre, and within 3 mm of the height at which the bob rests on the dock floor (bob centre 22 mm above the floor's top surface). All of this must hold for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task.

task_failures: obstacle_collision: at any time the carrier bar or the pendulum (rod or bob) touches the obstacle block.
carrier_grasp_lost: at any time the bar's centre drops below z = 0.16 m (with the bob resting in the dock and the bar held above it, the bar's centre is at about 0.199 m).
contact_rules: No tool is mounted. Only the finger links (fingers and finger pads) may touch anything, and only the carrier bar. Touching the pendulum (rod or bob) with a finger is forbidden. So is touching the ledges, the obstacle, the dock or the table. No other part of the robot (hand, links, base) may touch anything. The pendulum is expected to touch the dock; neither the bar nor the pendulum may touch the obstacle.
world_goals_fixed: Waypoint A (-0.05, 0.04, 0.38) and waypoint B (0.0, 0.15, 0.37), each with radius 3.5 cm, for the bar's centre (announced at reset as `goal_waypoints`). Bar-centre floor: z = 0.16 m.
world_goals_seeded: Nothing goal-related is seeded. `goal_goal` (announced at reset) is fixed, but it gives the dock's position (the bar-centre point with the bob resting in the dock), so it is privileged mode only.
difficulty_note: The pendulum is nearly undamped and is driven only through the bar's motion. Every acceleration of the hand, through the turn and the braking, excites it again, and it must be settled three times, the last while the bob sits in a small dock.
standard_notes: The pendulum is already swinging at t = 0 and keeps swinging until the gripper's motion damps it. The carrier is free: it only rests on the two ledges, so if the fingers let go it falls.
